final: WITH circuit_counts AS (SELECT circuitId, AVG(round) AS average_round, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), ranked AS (SELECT circuitId, average_round, race_count, race_count * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races) AS race_share, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY race_count * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races) DESC) AS share_rank FROM circuit_counts) SELECT c.circuitId, c.name, ranked.average_round, ranked.race_count, ranked.race_share FROM ranked JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = ranked.circuitId WHERE share_rank <= 10 ORDER BY race_share DESC, c.circuitId
